deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is a heavily corrected draft of the opening paragraph and a chronological note for Riemann's 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen' (Crelle's Journal 54, 1857).

(1) The opening sentence matches the printed text almost word for word. It reads: 'In der folgenden Abhandlung habe ich die Abel'schen Functionen nach einer Methode behandelt, deren Principien in meiner Inauguraldissertation aufgestellt und in einer etwas veränderten Form in den drei Aufsätzen No ... dargestellt worden sind; zur Erleichterung der Uebersicht schicke ich eine kurze Inhaltsangabe voraus.' The 'drei Aufsätze' are the three preliminary papers in the same Crelle volume:
- the Lehrsätze aus der analysis situs;
- the Allgemeine Voraussetzungen und Hülfsmittel;
- Bestimmung einer Function einer veränderlichen complexen Grösse durch Grenz- und Unstetigkeitsbedingungen.
The number was left blank ('No ...') pending journal numbering.

(2) Several abandoned starts follow and are struck through: 'Bis auf die Sätze §. 26 u 27 enthält ...', 'Einleitung', 'Abth[eilung]', 'die Aufsätze'.

(3) Under the heading 'Abel' there are successive versions of a statement on the paper's origin. The final layer: 'Die ganze gegenwärtige Abhandlung bildet mit Ausnahme der §§. 26 u 27, da [der Gegenstand] nur kurz umgearbeitet werden konnte, [den Inhalt] meiner Michaelis 1855 bis Michaelis 1856 zu Göttingen gehaltenen Vorlesungen.' §§26–27 are the closing sections of the second part, on theta functions; they are excluded from the lectures.

(4) A chronology of discovery follows:
- §§1–5, 9 and 12, with the necessary preliminary work, were found in autumn 1851 and early 1852.
- Riemann was then drawn away from the investigation by another subject.
- He resumed it around Easter 1855 (Osterferien) and carried it up to §21 inclusive.
- The rest was added Michaelis 1855 to Michaelis 1856. One correction layer reads 'Ostern 1855 bis Michaelis 1856'.
Crossed-out variants try 'im Sommer 1851' and 'Anfang 185[2]'.

Context: the previous page is a letter draft to the journal editor ('Hochgeschätzter Herr Doctor', presumably Borchardt) about the figures (Ringfläche) for these papers. The next page has notes dated August–September 1855 on the genus count p = 2((n-1)(m-1) - α) for a plane curve with double points. That date is consistent with the 'Easter 1855 resumption' stated here.

Nothing is derived, so there is nothing to reconstruct mathematically.
errors: No mathematical errors (no mathematics on the page).

The dating is internally inconsistent across correction layers: 'Mich 1855 bis 1856' vs. an inserted 'Ostern' before '1855 bis Michaelis 1856'. 'Ostern' seems to refer to the resumption, and the final printed version should be consulted.
§§1-5 are said to be excepted from the lectures in one crossed-out layer, while a later layer excepts §§26-27. These are different drafts, not a contradiction in the final text.

results.what: Draft preface stating that the method rests on the principles of the 1851 dissertation and the three preliminary Crelle papers, followed by a table of contents.
results.modern_name: Introduction to Riemann's 1857 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen'

results.what: Chronology of discovery: §§1-5, 9, 12 in autumn 1851/early 1852; interruption; resumed Easter 1855 up to §21; remainder Michaelis 1855-Michaelis 1856; paper ≈ content of the 1855/56 Göttingen lectures except §§26-27.
results.modern_name: Biographical/chronological note on the genesis of Riemann's theory of Abelian functions
results.usually_credited_to: Riemann's own statement; essentially printed in the 1857 paper and used by historians (e.g. Laugwitz, Bottazzini–Gray)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a draft of the introduction and dating note essentially as printed in Crelle 54 (1857). The variant dates in the struck-through layers (e.g. 'Sommer 1851') are of minor philological interest only. There is no mathematical content.
transcription_corrections: 'dasselbe nur kurz umgearbeitet werden konnte' is more likely 'derselbe nur kurz ...' (referring to a struck 'Gegenstand').
'ich ward aber' reads more like 'ich wurde aber'.
'welche schon der Kern der Vorlesungen' is very uncertain; possibly 'welche später [Stoff/Theil] der Vorlesungen, soweit sie in diese Abhandlung gefasst ist'.
'wurden ausgeführt[?] wurde' is probably a single reading, 'ausgeführt wurde'. The line concerns working out the preliminary results 'im Herbst 1851 und Anfang 1852'.

'ferner; das Übrige wurde ...' is a marginal insertion at right replacing the struck 'das Übrige wurde auf von Mich 1855 bis 1856'. 'Ostern' above '1855' belongs to the final reading '1855 bis Michaelis 1856 hinzugefügt'.
In line 2 of the 'Abel' block the struck words are 'bildet' / 'beim Inhalt', with 'wurde ... in' inserted above.
